title: Robotic Testing Systems
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Read a percentage contribution figure as the output of a superposition experiment under a stated load.
Expect the same structure to contribute different proportions under different loads and at different flexion angles.
Treat robotic results as the best available attribution of restraint and not as a measure of clinical laxity.
Ask how the simulated clinical test was defined, since laboratories differ and the definition drives the result.
Expect muscle simulation to change the contribution of muscle associated structures materially.
Compare robotic findings within a laboratory's protocol rather than across laboratories.
Use robotic findings to explain mechanism and clinical studies to establish outcome, and keep the two roles separate in discussion.
Treat a construct designed from robotic data as mechanically rational and clinically unproven until a trial says otherwise.
State that the method's external validity has never been measured.
Expect cross laboratory figures to disagree, and compare within a protocol.

Weigh the patient's age and physiology, comorbidities, knee demand, psychological state and their own ideas, concerns and expectations when a construct is being chosen on mechanical grounds, because mechanical rationality is not by itself an indication.
